compared.difference: Flattening is a general prerequisite but does not construct the circle H-space or identify the Hopf total space. This is distinct from Freudenthal connectivity and circle path-space computation.

A Whitehead result for test categories has different objects and hypotheses; not this finitely truncated type theorem.
